name: nv1-candidate-b-bounded-probe
description: Bounded probe of NV-1 candidate (b) conj:nv-as-bring-period-rank. Verifies primality of N_v=1,445,519 and computes minimum-irrep-multiplicity decompositions in three S_5-relevant dim sets. Closed-form arithmetic only; not a substitute for the Bring period-lattice machinery.

decompositions.method: Closed-form modular arithmetic. For S = {4, 5, 6}: minimise a+b+c over 4a+5b+6c = N. Substitute a = (N - 5b - 6c)/4 and observe total = (N - 2c - b)/4, so minimising count is equivalent to maximising 2c + b subject to feasibility and divisibility (b + 2c ≡ N mod 4 = 3). Push c to N//6 then adjust b in O(200) range; verified globally optimal.

S_5_dims_4_5_6_only.note: S_5 has 7 irreps with dims {1,1,4,4,5,5,6} (Klein 1888). Restricting to dims >= 4 (i.e. ignoring the two trivial-dim channels) gives the same integer cone as {4, 5, 6} since duplicate dims add no new sums.

S_5_x_Z2_dims_4_5_6_only.note: S_5 × Z/2 has dims {1,1,1,1,4,4,4,4,5,5,5,5,6,6}. Same min-count as plain S_5 when restricting to dims >= 4.

no_trivial_4_5_6.lower_bound: N // 6 = 240919; min count exceeds this by exactly 1 because N mod 6 = 5, so we must replace one dim-6 with one dim-5 (cost +1, fills 5 units).

trivial_dim_lower_bound.note: If dim-1 channels are allowed without penalty (i.e. counting only dim->=4 multiplicities), the absolute bound is N // 6 = 240919, attained by 4a+5b+6c+e = N with e arbitrary in dim-1; but the dim-1 channel is then carrying e = 5 trivial-rep copies, which would itself be a multiplicity of 5 — and that resurfaces in any natural rank reading.

verdict_rationale: N_v is prime, ruling out any non-trivial multiplicative factorisation across irrep dims.
The minimum count using {4, 5, 6} alone is 240,920 — nearly 10^6 magnitude, dominated by ~240,919 copies of the dim-6 irrep plus a single dim-5 copy, with zero dim-4 copies.
This decomposition is highly degenerate: it concentrates almost entirely on a single irrep channel.

For candidate (b) to hold, the Bring period sub-lattice would have to land on this exact unnatural multiplicity profile (one dominant channel) at the weak-place projection. While not strictly impossible, it requires fine-tuning and would itself need a structural explanation.
Threshold rule: min count > 1000 => falsification-leaning (per probe spec); 240,920 >> 1000.
caveat: This is a probe, not a closure. 'Natural' is fuzzy — a Bring-period rank could in principle realise any specific positive integer, prime or composite, without an irrep-decomposition reading at all. The probe only weakens the candidate as an *intuitively appealing* path; it does not refute the rank-equality numerical claim itself.
handoff: Full Bring-period-lattice machinery (Riemann period integration on y^2 = x^5 - 1) remains research-grade open work. See docs/audits/conjecture-cones.md and the candidate-(b) entry of docs/audits/2026-05-02-nv-frob-filter-conjectures.md.
scope_note: STRICT scope: closed-form arithmetic only, no DP arrays of size > 10^4. Optimisation completed in O(200) iterations rather than O(N) DP.
